items.t: Said he thinks Arizona has too many politicians who believe government should dictate which industries get to thrive.
items.q: I think Arizona has too many radical politicians who believe government should dictate which industries get to thrive," Petersen, R-Maricopa, told Fox News Digital Tuesday.

items.t: Filed two lawsuits, together with House Speaker Ben Toma and the Arizona Trucking Association, in the U.S. Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia to stop recently adopted EPA rules requiring a transition from gas-powered vehicles to electric vehicles.
items.q: President Petersen, House Speaker Ben Toma, and the Arizona Trucking Association filed two lawsuits in the U.S. Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia to stop recently adopted rules by the EPA

items.t: Said Arizona has passed laws and litigated in court to ensure only girls play in girls sports, and that the executive order adds to this approach.
items.q: We now have a multi-pronged approach to making sure that only girls play in girls sports and boys cannot play in girls sports," Petersen said. "We've passed laws to do this. We've been litigating in the courts

record.t: Sent a letter to Secretary Burgum asking for a meeting to discuss ending the national monument designation and the prohibition on uranium mining.
record.q: This past Friday, President Petersen sent a letter to Secretary Burgum laying out the dire consequences of Biden's land grab, as well as former President Barack Obama's 2009 prohibition on mining uranium, and asked for a meeting to discuss ending this government overreach.

record.t: Was elected to the Arizona House of Representatives in 2012.
record.q: Mr. Petersen was elected to the Arizona House of Representatives in 2012.

record.t: Served as House Majority Leader, Senate Commerce Committee Chair, Senate Judiciary Committee Chair and Senate Rules Chair, and as a member of the Senate Ethics Committee.
